channel.title: Español para la familia
channel.description: A hands-free Spanish course for one specific dinner table. Someone speaks, you answer out loud in the gap. Days 1 to 14 are Sofía's family in neutral Latin American Spanish. Days 15 to 21 are Sofía herself, in Argentine.
channel.itunes:author: Griffin Thomas

item.title: 1. Llegando a la casa
item.description: tú vs. usted. The scene, five words, one grammar point, the conversation, then everything from the days before it. Say your answers out loud in the gaps.

item.title: 2. En la mesa
item.description: ser vs. estar con comida. The scene, five words, one grammar point, the conversation, then everything from the days before it. Say your answers out loud in the gaps.

item.title: 3. Hablando de tu trabajo
item.description: llevar + tiempo. The scene, five words, one grammar point, the conversation, then everything from the days before it. Say your answers out loud in the gaps.
